name: Tellyard
description: A live TV tuner for Plex and Jellyfin that you'll forget is running. Tellyard shows up in Plex and Jellyfin as a network tuner. You list your channels in one file. When someone tunes in, Tellyard finds the channel's live stream on YouTube, Twitch, a broadcaster's page or an HLS address and passes it on without re-encoding. When they stop watching, it stops. The guide merges XMLTV schedules with placeholder blocks, so it is never empty. Tellyard ships no channels. It starts with an empty line-up: put your channels.toml in /mnt/user/appdata/tellyard/config and it is loaded within a minute. Then add the tuner in Plex at Unraid-IP:5004 and the guide at http://Unraid-IP:5004/guide.xml.

paths.name: Channels
paths.description: Folder with your channels.toml. Tellyard reloads it within a minute of a change.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Guide and yt-dlp caches. Rebuilt when missing.

ports.name: Tuner Port
ports.description: Port Plex and Jellyfin use for the tuner, the guide and the /healthz check.

variables.name: Tuners
variables.description: Streams that may play at the same time.

variables.name: Minimum Height
variables.description: Lowest resolution tellyard check accepts, such as 1080. off accepts any. A channel's own min_height in channels.toml overrides it.

variables.name: Device ID
variables.description: 8 hexadecimal characters. Plex remembers the tuner by this.

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: Address Plex should use, such as http://192.168.1.10:5004. Set it when the address Plex connects with is not reachable for streams.

variables.name: Guide Refresh Hours
variables.description: How often the guide is rebuilt.

variables.name: yt-dlp Arguments
variables.description: Extra yt-dlp arguments, for example extractor options.

variables.name: Heartbeat URL
variables.description: Address Tellyard calls once a minute while it is healthy, for a monitor such as Uptime Kuma or Healthchecks.
